title: AVL Tree Self-Righting Rotation Lab
concept: Left-Right (LR) and Right-Left (RL) Double Rotations to restore balance factor [-1, 0, 1].
code_snippet:
def right_rotate(y):
    x = y.left
    T2 = x.right
    x.right = y
    y.left = T2
    return x
